$description: Gruvbox base palette. Hard-coded hex from the canonical gruvbox scheme (morhetz/gruvbox). Light and dark are complete, independent ramps — dark is not derived from light. These are RAW material; semantic mapping lives in tokens/semantic.json.

gruvbox.$description: Neutral ramps. bg0..bg4 = surfaces darkest→lightest in that scheme's orientation; fg0..fg4 = text lightest→darkest contrast; gray = the mid neutral shared by both.

accent.$description: Hue ramp. `bright` reads well on dark surfaces; `neutral` and the darker `faded` read well on light surfaces. The contrast gate (make check) decides which variant each imprint uses per scheme — see tokens/accents.json.

tuned.$description: AA-tuned variants — the ONLY deviations from canonical gruvbox in this repo. Each is a minimal sRGB shade (≤~4%) of the nearest canonical variant, made because the canonical hue could not clear its WCAG threshold on the binding gruvbox surface. Every one is re-verified by `make check`. Named <hue>-<role>-<scheme>: `aa` = AA 4.5:1 text, `ui` = 3:1 decorative/large.
